title: Remove Tip (or A-Axis) Cable From Tipper/A-Axis Carriage
summary: Safely remove the Tip (A-Axis) cable from the OptiSweep tipper station by performing LOTO, removing the station side panel and valve cover, disconnecting the four M8 connectors, routing the cable through the grommet, opening the snap-open cable carrier, cutting cable ties, and unplugging the cable from the A-axis PCA.
when_to_use: Use when the Tip (or A-Axis) cable must be physically disconnected/removed from the tipper station (e.g., for maintenance/replacement), following the manual’s removal steps.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform LOTO and all physical disconnection/removal steps (side panel/valve cover removal, M8 connector disconnection, cable tie cutting, and unplugging from the A-axis PCA).
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before removing the side panel/valve cover and disconnecting the cable.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station for LOTO and panel/cover removal
Wire ties (for later reinstallation, implied by required tools list)
3/8-in. wrench or socket (if side panel removal is necessary)

access_required: Physical floor access to the OptiSweep tipper station
system_preconditions: Tipper is placed under LOTO (per manual reference to "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

visual_references.description: Figure 7-15: Tip Cable (shows the Tip (A-Axis) cable referenced by the removal procedure).
Figure 7-16: Tip Cable Routing (shows the routing path for the Tip (A-Axis) cable inside the tipper station).
Removal procedure diagram for Tip (or A-Axis) cable: M8 connectors, grommet, snap-open cable carrier cross bars, cable tie locations, and A-axis PCA unplug point.

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is locked out/tagged out before any panel/cover removal or electrical connector disconnection.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the tipper (manual references "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).
steps.expected_result: Tipper is under LOTO prior to proceeding to side panel/valve cover removal and cable disconnection.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is in place and you can proceed with safe access to the station components.
steps.failure_condition: LOTO is not completed or cannot be verified before proceeding.

actions.label: Apply LOTO to tipper
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: If LOTO cannot be completed, stop and escalate to FORTNA support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 1: "LOTO the tipper (see \"Operator Station Lockout/Tagout\" on page 2)."

steps.title: Remove the station side panel to access the motor (if necessary)
steps.purpose: Provide access to the valve cover and cable routing area inside the tipper station.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping screws securing the side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed, exposing the motor access area for subsequent valve cover removal.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panel removal is complete and the motor/access area is reachable for the next step.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel cannot be removed as described (e.g., screws not accessible or not removable).

actions.label: Remove side panel screws
actions.exact_action: use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate to FORTNA support if access to the motor/valve cover cannot be achieved as described.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 2: "If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor."

steps.title: Remove the valve cover
steps.purpose: Expose the valve cover area so the Tip (A-Axis) cable connections can be accessed/disconnected.
steps.instruction: Remove the valve cover by removing the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws.
steps.expected_result: Valve cover is removed after taking out the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Valve cover is fully removed and the cable connection area is accessible.
steps.failure_condition: Valve cover cannot be removed because screws are not removed or cover remains secured.

actions.label: Remove valve cover screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the valve cover by removing the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate to FORTNA support if the valve cover cannot be removed as described.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 3: "Remove the valve cover by removing the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws."

steps.title: Disconnect all four (4) M8 connectors
steps.purpose: Unplug the Tip (A-Axis) cable electrical connections from the A-axis carriage.
steps.expected_result: All four M8 connectors are disconnected from the A-axis carriage.
steps.healthy_condition: No M8 connectors remain physically connected.
steps.failure_condition: One or more M8 connectors remain connected.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check if any M8 connectors remain connected.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 4: "Disconnect all four (4) M8 connectors."

steps.title: Route the cable through the grommet and feed M8 connectors one at a time
steps.purpose: Remove the cable from the station while ensuring the connectors pass through the grommet correctly.
steps.instruction: Pull the jacketed part of the cable out of the grommet, then feed all the M8 connectors through the grommet one at a time.
steps.expected_result: Cable jacket is pulled out of the grommet and all four M8 connectors have been fed through the grommet.
steps.healthy_condition: Cable and connectors are free of the grommet path and can be moved toward the cable carrier.
steps.failure_condition: Cable cannot be pulled free after opening the cable carrier cross bars (or connectors cannot pass through the grommet).

actions.label: Pull jacket and feed connectors through grommet
actions.exact_action: Pull the jacketed part of the cable out of the grommet, then feed all the M8 connectors through the grommet one at a time.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check if the cable cannot be pulled free after opening the cable carrier cross bars.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 5: "Pull the jacketed part of the cable out of the grommet and then feed all the M8 connectors through the grommet one at a time."

steps.title: Open the snap-open cable carrier cross bars
steps.purpose: Allow the cable to be removed from the cable carrier.
steps.instruction: Open all of the cross bars on the outside of the cable carrier (snap-open type).
steps.expected_result: All cable carrier cross bars are opened (carrier is unlatched for cable removal).
steps.healthy_condition: Carrier cross bars are fully opened so the cable can be lifted/removed.
steps.failure_condition: Cross bars are not fully opened, preventing cable removal.

actions.label: Snap-open carrier cross bars
actions.exact_action: Open all of the cross bars on the cable carrier.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check if the cable cannot be pulled free after opening the cable carrier cross bars.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 6: "The cross bars on the outside of the cable carrier can be \"snapped open.\" Open all of the cross bars on the cable carrier."

steps.title: Mark the cable on both ends where it enters the cable carrier
steps.purpose: Preserve cable orientation/positioning for later reinstallation (or transfer to the new cable).
steps.instruction: Use tape or a marker to mark the cable on both ends where the cable enters the cable carrier.
steps.expected_result: Two cable entry marks are applied (one at each end where the cable enters the cable carrier).
steps.healthy_condition: Marks are visible and correspond to the cable entry points into the carrier.
steps.failure_condition: Marks are missing, unclear, or not placed at the cable entry points.

actions.label: Apply tape/marker marks
actions.exact_action: Use tape or a marker to mark the cable on both ends where the cable enters the cable carrier.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 7: "Use tape or a marker to mark the cable on both ends where the cable enters the cable carrier."

steps.title: Cut cable ties at both carrier ends and the A-axis carriage tie point
steps.purpose: Free the cable from the carrier and carriage tie-down points so it can be unplugged from the A-axis PCA.
steps.instruction: Note how the cable ties are situated at both ends of the carrier (take a picture) and cut the cable ties holding the cable to the cable carrier at both ends and the tie point on the A-axis carriage.
steps.expected_result: Cable ties at both carrier ends and the A-axis carriage tie point are cut, freeing the cable from those restraints.
steps.healthy_condition: No cable ties remain holding the cable at the carrier ends or the A-axis carriage tie point.
steps.failure_condition: A cable tie remains uncut at either carrier end or the A-axis carriage tie point.

actions.label: Cut cable ties
actions.exact_action: cut the cable ties holding the cable to the cable carrier at both ends and the tie point on the A-axis carriage.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check if the cable is still attached by an uncut cable tie near the A-axis PCA (the procedure notes there may be one more cable tie to cut near the PCA).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 8: "Note how the cable ties are situated at both ends of the carrier (take a picture) and cut the cable ties holding the cable to the cable carrier at both ends and the tie point on the A-axis carriage."

steps.title: Unplug from the A-axis PCA and remove from the cable carrier
steps.purpose: Complete removal by disconnecting the cable from the A-axis PCA and extracting it from the carrier.
steps.instruction: Unplug the cable from the A-axis PCA and remove it from the cable carrier. There may be one more cable tie to cut near the PCA.
steps.expected_result: Cable is unplugged from the A-axis PCA and removed from the cable carrier.
steps.healthy_condition: No cable remains connected to the A-axis PCA; cable is fully extracted from the carrier.
steps.failure_condition: Cable remains attached near the PCA due to an uncut tie or incomplete unplugging.

actions.label: Unplug from A-axis PCA
actions.exact_action: Unplug the cable from the A-axis PCA and remove it from the cable carrier.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check if the cable is still attached by an uncut cable tie near the A-axis PCA (the procedure notes there may be one more cable tie to cut near the PCA).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 9: "Unplug the cable from the A-axis PCA and remove it from the cable carrier. There may be one more cable tie to cut near the PCA."

steps.title: Transfer the markings to the new cable
steps.purpose: Preserve the cable entry/orientation reference for correct reinstallation on the replacement cable.
steps.instruction: Transfer the markings from Step 5 to the new cable.
steps.expected_result: Marks from the original cable are applied to the new cable at the corresponding entry points.
steps.healthy_condition: New cable has the same tape/marker markings at both ends where it enters the cable carrier.
steps.failure_condition: Markings are missing or not transferred to the new cable.

actions.label: Transfer markings
actions.exact_action: Transfer the markings from Step 5 to the new cable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.15.1 REMOVAL step 10: "Transfer the markings from Step 5 to the new cable."

success_criteria: All four M8 connectors are disconnected.
Cable jacket is routed through the grommet and the cable is removed from the cable carrier.
Cable carrier cross bars are opened.
Cable ties at both carrier ends and the A-axis carriage tie point are cut.
Cable is unplugged from the A-axis PCA.
healthy_conditions: No M8 connectors remain connected to the A-axis carriage.
Cable is fully extracted from the cable carrier and unplugged from the A-axis PCA.
failure_conditions: Cable cannot be pulled free after opening the cable carrier cross bars.
Cable remains attached due to an uncut tie near the A-axis PCA.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to FORTNA support if LOTO cannot be completed or if access to the motor/valve cover cannot be achieved as described.
